what_happened: The job "Re-study firstmate work handling and add pin-consistency check" ended failed. The producer's final report was sent back with problems still present. Six acceptance criteria were unmet or not reported: (1) pin.json and every citation label name one identical commit, with the CHANGELOG stating the pin decision; (2) claims.json has cited claims on teardown reopening a backlog item, on yolo on and off, and on what frees a place; (3) model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json agree with the claims, use only existing claim ids, and say local-only ships and scouts hold their place until cleanup; (4) the rebuilt index.html shows the three corrected behaviors citing the pinned commit with quotes that exist there; (5) the final report has a table mapping each requirement to evidence; (6) `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` run clean. The event lists no blocker or major findings. Nothing was delivered. This is a retry of the same request that failed as job 20261015-214235-be8x, and the same gaps remained.
cause: Completion is judged only once, on the producer's final report. Nothing forces the producer to build a criterion-to-evidence table, or to run and record the gate commands, before it may report done. The retry reused the same eight-part request, which bundled code, content re-derivation, provenance and a rebuild, and which listed commands as acceptance items. The failure of the first attempt did not change the process. The earlier gaps were not carried forward as a checklist, and a report missing the evidence table was still accepted as a final report. The criteria that depend on pinned-commit quotes and on rendered HTML also have no mechanical cross-check before the report. This is the fifth case in this class.
prevention: Add a code gate that rejects the producer's final report before verification unless: (a) it contains an evidence entry for every acceptance criterion id, and (b) the gate commands (cargo test, clippy, fmt, the site build) have recorded exit codes from a run on the final tree. Treat commands as checks run by the harness, not as acceptance criteria. For the study content, make the pin-consistency check and a quote-exists-at-pinned-commit check part of that gate, so mismatched labels or missing quotes fail the gate and not the verdict. When a job is a retry of a failed job, pass the earlier unmet criteria to the producer as a required checklist.
proposed_request: Fix the firstmate study so it is accurate and consistent, and publish the rebuilt page. Outcome: the explainer page correctly shows three behaviors, each cited at one pinned commit with quotes that exist at that commit: (1) teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it, and under what condition; (2) with yolo on, firstmate merges green work itself, and what happens with yolo off; (3) only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, relaunches and secondmates are never counted, and local-only ships and scouts keep their place until cleanup. Also add a pin-consistency check to the site build that compares the mounted source commit, the pin.json sha and every sha label in claims.json and rationales.json, and fails naming the differing values. Include a test with a mismatched label. Acceptance criteria: pin.json and all citation labels name one commit and the CHANGELOG states the pin decision; claims.json holds cited claims (path, quote, line) for the three behaviors; model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json agree with the claims and reference only existing claim ids; the rebuilt index.html shows the three behaviors with quotes that exist at the pinned commit. Work method: before reporting done, run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check and `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, and include their exit codes in the report with a table mapping every criterion to evidence (file and line, or command output). Do not report done if any row is empty. This is a retry of jobs 20261015-214235-be8x and 20261015-223418-qb41, which failed on these same criteria.
